body:
Astra integration checkpoint: closed serial batches 097–098 are published at cf0acb9bed43a66944c2f49e087a1c6ae3c9553d.

Both actual guards passed without stop/error: 097 in 429.424 s and 098 in 421.379 s, with 16 fresh dependency modules (3413–3428). Owner readback authenticated the exact sources, commands, receipts, logs and all 80 output files; next prefix is 3429/3591. The unchanged policy remains one compiler, 6 GiB virtual and 4 GiB physical stop, with the existing time/disk/RAM/pause gates. An elevated sampled-memory observation in098 did not become a guard stop; its real final receipt is preserved.

Remote readback verified 11 changed subtrees and 20 individual blobs, preserving seven peer paths from three intervening commits. Seven reviewed source packets (bridge taxon cuts, protected trace, class budget, affine bank flip, explicit namespace successor, generic prefix support and protected blob incidence), their separate reviews, and the exact provider/protection request are included as UNCOMPILED/UNSELECTED proposals. Original frozen sources and the active plan are unchanged. The hand protection contract found uses fully expanded PE/PH with |PE|+|PH| ≤ h; PV=Empty specializes the proposed incidence bound to2h, while actual-input adequacy/dependencies and the exact0616 provider body remain unresolved.

Current319 provider/support, actual final Lake, full theorem-type and axiom audits are still pending. Original042/057/059 missing outer outcomes remain UNKNOWN. Live099 was excluded from publication. By the revised coordination gate,099 and100 may finish; no101 launches until review of a narrow fresh BankPrefixSupport proof check. This checkpoint reports external execution and source preservation, not master/physical/native completion.
